name: Research Portal
description: A simulated research-management application containing controlled security assessment scenarios.
objective: Perform an authorized security assessment of the simulated application and identify weaknesses affecting confidentiality, integrity or access control.

http.request:
GET /api/profile?id=1001 HTTP/1.1
Host: research.lab
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0
Cookie: session=LAB_SESSION

api_endpoints.description: Retrieve the simulated profile associated with a resource identifier.
Controlled scenario representing access to another user's resource.

vulnerabilities.title: Broken Access Control
vulnerabilities.description: A simulated normal user can access a resource belonging to another user because server-side authorization is not adequately enforced.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Enforce authorization server-side and verify that the authenticated user is permitted to access the requested resource.

vulnerabilities.title: Information Disclosure
vulnerabilities.description: A simulated response exposes unnecessary technical information that could assist further application analysis.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Limit externally visible technical information and configure application responses to expose only information required by the client.
